title: ubank Oct '25 Interest Changes, Did You Leave a Bad Review?
body:
Hey all,
I've been at war with Ubank since their interest criteria changes last year and just wanted to encourage everyone who left and vented on here but didn't leave a bad review to consider doing so. I was initially jaded as my monthly deposit earlier this year went into my spend account by mistake, rather than the save one, which had been fine before October. It cost me a small fortune in lost interest. They wouldn't even entertain a partial reimbursement for me, a customer of 15 years,
Since then i've heard many stories about people who can least afford it being negatively impacted by the changes. And before people say, if you're not happy just leave. Yes, people are free to do so if they're not happy with the t&c's. My recent dealings with them, however, suggest that even the great exodus of late 2025 has done little to dent their arrogance. I was hoping perhaps some more heat in their online reviews might lead to a wind back.
Cheers
